name: The Coldbringer's Eye
summary: A servant of the Lich King watches through the Coldbringer’s Eye from Razorfen Downs. You are asked to recover the orb so covert Scourge agents on Kalimdor can be hunted.

sections.title: An Orb in the Lair
sections.body: A scrying orb lets Amnennar the Coldbringer observe and direct minions elsewhere. He dwells deep in Razorfen Downs, a lair of the Death's Head quilboar. You are asked to retrieve the Coldbringer's Eye, which may help hunt the Scourge's covert agents on Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Amnennar the Coldbringer is a servant of the Lich King who dwells in Razorfen Downs.
The Coldbringer's Eye is a scrying orb Amnennar uses to observe and direct his minions elsewhere.
The Coldbringer's Eye is in Razorfen Downs, in Amnennar the Coldbringer's lair.
The orb could help hunt covert agents of the Scourge on Kalimdor and end the threat they pose.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Coldbringer's Eye
